$doc: Labelled first messages for the intake decision (round 9, packages/shared/src/intake.ts). Each case is a thread's first human message as Home sends it (no threadKind). `expect` is the kind and the workspace a correct intake gives. `accept` lists other kinds that are also correct for a case that is not clear (ambiguous cases are reported, never gated). `{repo}` is replaced by the name of the repository the eval adds to the project. Categories: coding-greenfield and coding-repo are the CLEAR CODING set (target 95% or more, kind and workspace both right). question is the set that must never route to coding (target 0 coding routes). content, research, board and ambiguous are reported.
